keyboardHintNavigation: Click or press Enter to switch, Esc to close, Tab / arrows to navigate
setWidthTip: Width of the switcher dialog in pixels (480–1920)
setHeightTip: Height of the switcher dialog in pixels (360–1280)
setColumnsTip: Cards per row; "Auto" adapts to the window width
setThumbHeightTip: Height of each tab thumbnail in pixels (72–360)
setSortByTip: Default card order when opening the switcher; pinned tabs always come first
fullScreenTip: The switcher fills the whole window; press Esc to exit (off by default)
fullScreenOn: Fullscreen mode enabled. Press Esc to exit
setDocksTip: Unchecked panels are hidden from the left rail of the switcher
groupTip: Enter a group name; leave empty to remove from group
manageFavoritesTip: Create, rename, or delete groups and reassign favorites; changes save instantly
deleteGroupConfirm: Delete this group? Its favorites will move to ungrouped
fabEnabledTip: Off by default: show a floating action button on the bottom-right of the mobile screen to open the tab switcher; swipe up to hide, swipe down to show
mobileLayoutTip: Arrangement of tab cards on mobile
mobileNoFav: No favorites yet. Star a tab from the switcher to add it here.
mobileNeedsNewer: Tab switching on mobile requires SiYuan 3.8.0 or later. Please upgrade.
setDockDisplayTip: How the dock panel list shows on the left of the switcher: hidden gives the content full width; collapsed shows an icon rail with names on hover, expandable anytime
sidebarLayoutTip: When the sidebar is stretched wider: by default thumbnails enlarge to fill the width; or add columns automatically by width to show more thumbnails
emptyHint: Type keywords in the search box above to find and open documents from the whole workspace
journalNotebookTip: The notebook where today's journal is created when the top-bar journal button is clicked; opens a picker on first use if unset
journalChooseTip: Pick a default notebook for the journal feature; you can change it anytime under Settings → Journal
journalNoNotebook: No available notebooks. Create or open one in SiYuan first.
journalFailed: Failed to open the journal. Check the default notebook setting.
